mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payroll growth exceeding 200,000 jobs signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in < 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and confidence, leading to higher corporate revenues and elevated equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction effect size < 0.05 in regression models.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below its 12-month moving average indicates weakening manufacturing activity, signaling an upcoming economic slowdown that triggers risk-off behavior and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO downtrends (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts or initiate tightening, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% YoY (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < -0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust aggregate demand, reinforcing corporate revenue growth and investor confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST rise (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction term coefficient < 0.02 in regression models.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.5% combined with rising non-farm payrolls signals tight labor market conditions, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5.5 AND PAYEMS increases > 100.0 in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both conditions are met (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction effect size < 0.03 in predictive models.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 100 (index base 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, signaling a potential recession, which triggers equity market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 100 (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < -0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
